name: connectors
title: scm:merge, written once per forge
html:
scm:merge, written once per forge

# github-scm/pull.resource.yaml
merge:
  operation: pulls/merge
  fields: [commit_title, commit_message]
  inputs:
    method:
      enum: [merge, squash, rebase]
  values:
    method:
      merge:  {merge_method: merge}
      squash: {merge_method: squash}
      rebase: {merge_method: rebase}
  bind: {sha: /head/sha}
  stale: 409
  refused: 405

the whole merge act

# gitlab/pull.resource.yaml
merge:
  operation: pulls/merge
  fields: [merge_commit_message]
  inputs:
    method:
      enum: [merge, squash]
  values:
    method:
      merge:  {squash: false}
      squash: {squash: true}
  bind: {sha: /sha}
  stale: 409
  refused: 405
# + normal: state, merged, mergeable_state

the whole merge act
say: The merge act in each connector. Same relation, same input (method), same guard (the head sha the view had), same stale and refused codes. The upstream operation, the field names and the values differ, and only here.

deck:fragment.name: github-merge
deck:fragment.label: GitHub's merge act (github-scm/pull.resource.yaml)
deck:fragment.text:
merge:
  operation: pulls/merge
  title: Merge
  description: Merge the pull request into its base branch.
  fields: [commit_title, commit_message]
  # scm's method, as GitHub's merge_method takes it.
  inputs:
    method:
      type: string
      enum: [merge, squash, rebase]
      title: Merge method
      description: The merge method to use.
  values:
    method:
      merge: { merge_method: merge }
      squash: { merge_method: squash }
      rebase: { merge_method: rebase }
  # GitHub merges only if the head is still at this sha: the head the client's view had.
  bind: { sha: /head/sha }
  # GitHub's 409: the head moved, so the client's view is stale. Its 405: it can't merge now.
  stale: 409
  refused: 405

deck:fragment.name: gitlab-merge
deck:fragment.label: GitLab's merge act (gitlab/pull.resource.yaml)
deck:fragment.text:
merge:
  operation: pulls/merge
  title: Merge
  description: Merge the pull request into its target branch.
  fields: [merge_commit_message]
  # scm's method, as GitHub's merge takes it; GitLab squashes or not, and merges with a merge commit either way.
  inputs:
    method:
      type: string
      enum: [merge, squash]
      title: Merge method
      description: The merge method to use.
  values:
    method:
      merge: { squash: false }
      squash: { squash: true }
  # GitLab merges only if the source branch's head is still at this sha: the head the client's view had.
  bind: { sha: /sha }
  # GitLab's 409: the head moved, so the client's view is stale. Its 405: it can't merge now.
  stale: 409
  refused: 405
